description: This file defines a PHP trait called DateTimeHelperTrait within the namespace OrangeHRM\Core\Traits\Service. The trait provides a method to retrieve a DateTimeHelperService instance via dependency injection, utilizing a service container. It is part of a human resource management system's codebase, facilitating date-time related helper functions.

methods.name: getDateTimeHelper
methods.description: Returns an instance of DateTimeHelperService by retrieving it from the service container.
